treatment: Only accepted higher-level replacement Builder reservations survive routine production rescoring through their starting turn, including repeated observed frames. Legal continuation and siege/insolvency priorities remain required. No workforce quota, civilian safety or AI weight change.
configuration: Public targeted Domination enable_live_bridge(), fixed stock adaptive rivals; native simulation; 4 players, 60x38 Pangaea, Online, 150-turn clock, Gran Colombia focal, randomized stock rivals, focal handicap-exempt
baseline: Frozen #3932 repaired native executor candidate library. Both arms must include that executor repair; no two-change comparison.
primary_metric: Mean paired focal T75 Production, separate Emperor and Deity; dead or ended-before-T75 zero
secondary_metrics: Survival at T75 and game end
Actual Builder queues, completions and productive improvements
pilot_gate: Mean T75 Production positive at both difficulties, T75 survival not lower at either difficulty, and T75 mean science no more than 10% lower at either difficulty. Otherwise keep confirmation unplayed, report every assigned pilot, and investigate rather than claim a production gain.
confirmation_gate: Independent confirmation mean paired T75 Production at least 5% higher at both difficulties, T75 survival not lower at either difficulty, and T75 science no more than 10% lower. Report paired confidence intervals and sample limits; do not claim Firaxis parity from native play.
sampling_rule: Freeze exact paired binaries, dependency hashes and commands before any treatment/strength run. Complete and report every assigned pair including terminal errors. Consumed diagnostics are excluded from fresh strength. Do not pool pilot with confirmation.
